invariants_checked: Embedded HTTP backend binds 127.0.0.1 by default (0.0.0.0 only on explicit user preference), enforces Slowloris ReadHeaderTimeout/IdleTimeout/MaxHeaderBytes, and synchronizes backend port assignment via channel + RWMutex before Wails proxy initialization.

Desktop auto-update defaults to disabled, enforces HTTPS (loopback HTTP allowed for local test servers only) across release metadata, manifest/signature fetches, redirect hops, installer downloads, and BrowserOpenURL fallbacks, scopes GITHUB_TOKEN strictly to https://api.github.com, strips Authorization on cross-origin redirects, and verifies SHA-256 + optional Ed25519 signatures.

Local directory picker (PickProjectDir) serializes concurrent invocations, requires user-selected native dialog approval, and WebView JS injection preserves the __wkDragBound negative brand-residue guard.

findings.summary: Embedded desktop HTTP server lacked Slowloris ReadHeaderTimeout/IdleTimeout/MaxHeaderBytes guards, and main() slept a fixed 500ms while reading/writing App.backendURL, App.apiLanBaseURL, App.listenPublic, and App.ctx across goroutines without synchronization.

Desktop updater attached GITHUB_TOKEN unconditionally to non-GitHub custom GENYEE_UPDATE_URL hosts, accepted cleartext non-loopback HTTP/unsafe-scheme URLs and unvalidated redirects across release/manifest/installer fetches and BrowserOpenURL, accepted path-traversal segments in GENYEE_UPDATE_REPO, and formatted nil err on invalid GENYEE_UPDATE_PUBLIC_KEY.

invariants_checked: DuckDB extension bootstrap enforces a bounded context timeout, verifies allow_unsigned_extensions == false via duckdb_settings(), validates extension identifiers against SQL injection, and restricts any custom extension repository to clean HTTPS URLs without embedded credentials.
Single-file invocation compatibility (`go run cmd/download/duckdb/duckdb.go` in docker/Dockerfile.app) is preserved with stdlib + duckdb-go/v2 imports only.

findings.summary: downloadExtensions executed unbounded background SQL without timeout, extension identifier validation, allow_unsigned_extensions verification, or HTTPS validation on custom extension repositories.

invariants_checked: Primary HTTP server enforces Slowloris ReadHeaderTimeout (15s), IdleTimeout (120s), and MaxHeaderBytes (1 MiB) while leaving WriteTimeout unbounded for long-lived SSE chat streams.
Server listen address formatting uses net.JoinHostPort for IPv6 literal safety while preserving empty-host wildcard (:port) semantics.

Graceful shutdown cancels background Redis pubsub and model-catalog refresh contexts BEFORE resourceCleaner.Cleanup tears down Redis/DB pools, cancels background contexts on non-ErrServerClosed Serve failures, and exits signal watcher goroutines cleanly.

findings.summary: Primary HTTP server omitted ReadHeaderTimeout, IdleTimeout, and MaxHeaderBytes, formatted listen addresses with fmt.Sprintf breaking IPv6 literals, leaked background subscriber contexts on Serve errors, and cancelled background Redis/DB subscribers only after resourceCleaner.Cleanup closed underlying pools.

invariants_checked: Embedded migration and static asset declarations contain only expected repo-local SQL/asset paths with zero external network fetches, path traversal sinks, or legacy brand residues.

Archive, CSV, JSON, HTTP, and gRPC document parsers enforce per-entry (maxZipEntryBytes = 64 MiB), package (maxResultPackageBytes = 1 GiB), control-plane JSON (16 MiB), error-preview (4 KiB), and cumulative image memory budgets (GENYEE_MINERU_MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 512 MiB default) without OOM amplification.

JSON splitter respects context cancellation, caps split recursion depth, and measures chunk payload net of ancestor wrapper overhead; Markdown image target scanner executes in linear O(N) time on unclosed syntax; HTML table normalizer tracks CommonMark line-anchored fenced code blocks accurately.

ImageResolver allowlists stored image extensions, keys filename deduplication by SHA-256 content digest to prevent cross-directory basename collisions, rejects XML/SVG <!DOCTYPE and <!ENTITY directives, and validates remote image magic bytes and pixel budgets regardless of server Content-Type.

Cloud OCR readers (MinerU Cloud, PaddleOCR-VL Cloud) sanitize multipart upload filenames, percent-encode jobID/batchID path segments, infer SourceBlocks fileType from FileName when FileType is empty, and stream split PDF parts from disk under an overall timeout.

HTTPDocumentReader enforces getMaxFileSize() before base64 encoding, normalizes bare host:port addresses, and permits the exact operator-configured internal DOCREADER_ADDR with same-origin redirect pinning while enforcing full SSRF validation on all other URLs.

findings.summary: jsonToMarkdown ignored caller context cancellation, lacked an output Markdown byte cap, and measured chunk size inclusive of ancestor wrapper paths with unbounded split recursion, amplifying small deeply-wrapped JSON arrays into multi-GiB Markdown.
scanMarkdownImageTargets and findMarkdownImageTargetEnd exhibited quadratic O(N^2) scanning on repeated unclosed ![ markers, unclosed angle destinations, blank lines, and deep parentheses.

ImageResolver fell back to unsanitized ref.Filename extensions (allowing .html/.js/backslash names), keyed filename deduplication without content hashes (colliding distinct images sharing a basename across folders), allowed XML <!DOCTYPE/<!ENTITY directives in SVGs, trusted remote Content-Type: image/* headers without body magic/SVG validation or pixel-bomb checks, and copied full Markdown strings per image replacement.

GRPCDocumentReader.readStream/readUnary, MinerUReader.processImages, PaddleOCRVLReader.processImages, and PaddleOCRVLCloudReader.downloadImages omitted cumulative GENYEE_MINERU_MAX_IMAGE_BYTES caps, re-scanned full Markdown via regex per image, and GRPCDocumentReader.Close() left conn/client non-nil so IsConnected() stayed true.

Cloud readers sent unsanitized multipart filenames, omitted url.PathEscape on jobID/batchID poll URLs, dropped SourceBlocks when FileType was empty, buffered all split PDF part bytes in RAM without overall timeout/image-budget caps, read up to 1 GiB before checking non-200 HTTP status, inverted fenced code spans after mid-line triple backticks in NormalizeHTMLTables, and HTTPDocumentReader lacked getMaxFileSize() and operator DOCREADER_ADDR SSRF handling.
